description_en: Queries the status list of a cluster
name: DescribeDBClusterStatus

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

items.description_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:
Preparing: The cluster is being prepared.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Restoring: The cluster is being restored from a backup.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

ClassChanging: The cluster specifications are being changed.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: A network connection is being released.

NetAddressModifying: The network address is being modified.

EngineVersionUpgrading: The engine version is being upgraded
items.description_zh:

Running：运行中。

Deleting：删除中。

ClassChanging：变配中。

NetAddressCreating：创建网络中。

EngineVersionUpgrading：版本升级中
